figures_added.what: Real-life line graph for the plumber opener: cost against hours, plotting (0, GBP30) and (3, GBP90) with a straight line. currentColor axes/labels, soft #60a5fa line. Makes concrete the 'start cost = intercept, rate = gradient' claim the text makes.

Coordinate grid for 'gradient through (2,0) and (0,-6)': axes through origin, both named points plotted and joined by the line y = 3x - 6. Generated programmatically from the problem's own coordinates; verified the drawn line passes through both plotted points (< 1.5px).

notes: Equation-of-a-line is largely textual (equations and coordinates given), which SPEC_DIAGRAMS says is fine without a figure. Two figures added where the exam would actually print one: the real-life graph opener, and one coordinate grid on the two-point/intercept gold problem. All SVGs are self-contained (no external refs), theme-safe (text and axes use currentColor, region/line uses soft #60a5fa), role=img with descriptive aria-label, under 1.3KB each. Diagrams built in the same pass as the guided conversion.
